# West Tennessee State Fair — llms.txt
# https://wtsfair.com/llms.txt
# Last updated: 2026-09-28

> The West Tennessee State Fair is an annual agricultural and entertainment fair held at the Chester County Fairgrounds in Henderson, Tennessee. The 2026 fair runs October 15–24, 2026.

## About

The West Tennessee State Fair has been a regional tradition since 1855. It is organized by the West Tennessee Fair Association and serves Chester County and surrounding West Tennessee communities.

- **Location:** Chester County Fairgrounds, Henderson, TN 38340
- **2026 Dates:** October 15–24, 2026 (10 days)
- **Organization:** West Tennessee Fair Association
- **Website:** https://wtsfair.com

## 2026 Events & Entertainment

- **Bulls & Barrels – Buckin' by Faith** — Professional rodeo with bull riding and barrel racing
  - Friday, October 16 at 7:00 PM
  - Saturday, October 17 at 7:00 PM
- **Junior Rodeo** — Youth rodeo competition
  - Sunday, October 18 at 2:00 PM
- **WTSF Got Talent** — Talent competition for Kids (12 & under), Youth (13–20), and Adult (21+) divisions. $25 entry fee. Performances October 23–24, 2026.
